combo_label: The Garage × At the Funfair × Peter Pan

entries.clue: Sticky red coating on a fairground apple
Hissing flame from a small gas canister, played on a seized nut
Petrol-driven cutter wheeled out weekly to shorten the grass.
Fast spinning ride where the operator yells 'Scream if you wanna go faster'
Rank of Barrie's hook-handed pirate, in charge of the whole crew
Enamel biters a dentist counts, brushed morning and night
Stage venue where Barrie's boy took wing, seven years before the book
Scarred timber top along one wall, where every household repair happens.
Little low racer driven round a small circuit beside the rides
Dark hollow running back into a hillside, where bats roost and a chest might be hidden
Loud-voiced tout drumming up a crowd for the next attraction
Local dump, reached on a Saturday with the back seats down
